notes.title: 🎉Funding Ended!🎉
notes.content:
🎉 Our Kickstarter journey has ended! 🎉

Happy new year! Wish you all the best lucks first. 

On the last day of 2024, Wonder Library's funding on Kickstarter has successfully ended.

Thanks to 350 amazing backers, we raised $14,304 to bring Wonder Library to life. 🌟
Your support means the world to us, and we can’t wait to share this magical journey with you.

From now on, we'll do our best to make Wonder Library an amazing place to be relaxed. 
Stay tuned for updates! 💌

notes.title: 🌟 Dear Friends of Wonder Library 🌟
notes.content:
The journey we’ve all been dreaming of has finally begun—our Kickstarter campaign is now live! 📚✨

What started as a small idea—a picture book library nestled on a distant star—has grown into something truly magical. Wonder Library isn’t just a game; it’s a space for healing, imagination, and rediscovering hope. It’s for everyone who’s ever felt the weight of perfectionism and wanted to find joy in the little things again.

By joining us on Kickstarter, you’re not just funding a game—you’re helping to build a sanctuary for stories, memories, and moments of reflection. Every pledge is a step toward bringing this world to life and making the library a place we can all call home.

Together, we can create something extraordinary. Let’s rebuild this broken library and, in doing so, help others rebuild their own strength and hope.

🔗 Join us on Kickstarter now : http://kck.st/4fGWK74

Thank you for believing in this dream. Let’s turn the pages of Wonder Library together. 💖📖
